name: smwmusic-shatterhand-area-a
title: Shatterhand - Area A
description:
The very intense first stage theme from Shatterhand, with a soundtrack (made by Iku Mizutani) that is definitely one of the best OSTs you can find on the NES.

This song can fit both intense first level themes, and also fire level themes. Could also fit more final scenarios too, tho I'm not too sure about that if you ask me.
